content.short: 9Summits is an on-chain risk curator managing risk-managed vault strategies on Lagoon.
content.description: 9Summits curates and manages risk-managed on-chain vault strategies, running its flagship vaults on Lagoon. As a curator it selects the underlying markets and sets exposure limits, so depositors are relying on its judgement about risk rather than choosing positions themselves. It is active on Unichain.
content.meta: 9Summits is an onchain risk curator managing vault strategies on Lagoon, including on Unichain.
